page.layout: One page of an alphabetical Arabic word index in two columns, headed by a running title at the top. Left column: letter headings alif, ba, jim, ha, ra, each followed by entries with page numbers. Right column: letter headings sin, sad, ta, 'ayn, fa, kaf, mim, waw, each followed by entries with page numbers. Catchword "IN-" at the lower right, below the last line.
page.notes: The header letter of the last group (right column, after the mim group) is printed as a small form that I read as ن (nun) with [?]; the entry word beside it is read as وسوس. Several Arabic words are read from a faded scan and may be imperfect. Page numbers are printed in blue in the original and are copied as shown. The header of the ra group is also uncertain: it reads as ر with [?] in the scan.
